title: Dataset Curation & Direct Preference Optimization (DPO)
summary: Curate high-quality instruction datasets, filter contamination, and align model behavior using Direct Preference Optimization.
objectives: Generate and filter high-quality synthetic instruction pairs using LLM-in-the-loop validation.
Construct prompt-chosen-rejected preference datasets for alignment.
Train with Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) without complex RLHF reward models.

sections.title: Direct Preference Optimization over RLHF
paragraphs: Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) requires training a separate reward model and running unstable PPO optimization loops.
DPO mathematically reformulates preference optimization to directly optimize the policy language model using a closed-form loss over chosen vs rejected response pairs.

activity.reflectionPrompt: Why does data quality matter exponentially more than data quantity in DPO alignment runs?

questions.prompt: What advantage does DPO offer over traditional PPO-based RLHF?
choices: It eliminates the need to train and host an independent reward model during optimization.
It removes the requirement for any training datasets.
It makes models immune to hardware power failures.
questions.explanation: DPO optimizes policy model weights directly from pairwise preference data without training a separate reward model or tuning unstable reinforcement learning hyperparameters.
